text: What is the revised investment criteria for Micro Enterprises under the Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME) Act?
explanation: According to the revised MSME investment criteria, Micro Enterprises have an investment of up to ₹25 lakh, Small Enterprises have an investment of up to ₹5 crore, and Medium Enterprises have an investment of up to ₹10 crore.
subject: Business Studies

text: Which of the following schemes is provided by the National Small Industries Corporation (NSIC) to promote small industries?
explanation: NSIC provides various schemes such as Marketing and Technology Assistance Scheme, Quality Certification Scheme, and Export Promotion Scheme to promote small industries.
subject: Business Studies

text: What is the main objective of the District Industries Centres (DICs) in India?
options: To provide financial assistance to small industries
To provide technical assistance to small industries
To promote entrepreneurship in rural areas
To provide infrastructure support to small industries
correctAnswer: To promote entrepreneurship in rural areas
explanation: The main objective of DICs is to promote entrepreneurship in rural areas by providing various services such as market research, technology upgradation, and training.
subject: Business Studies

text: What is the revised turnover criteria for Small Enterprises under the Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME) Act?
explanation: According to the revised MSME turnover criteria, Small Enterprises have a turnover of up to ₹5 crore, Medium Enterprises have a turnover of up to ₹10 crore, and Large Enterprises have a turnover of more than ₹10 crore.
subject: Business Studies

text: Which of the following is a benefit of rural entrepreneurship?
explanation: Rural entrepreneurship can lead to the creation of employment opportunities, promotion of economic development, and reduction of poverty in rural areas.
subject: Business Studies

text: What is the role of District Industries Centres (DICs) in promoting rural entrepreneurship?
options: To provide financial assistance to rural entrepreneurs
To provide technical assistance to rural entrepreneurs
To promote entrepreneurship in rural areas
To provide infrastructure support to rural entrepreneurs
correctAnswer: To promote entrepreneurship in rural areas
explanation: DICs play a crucial role in promoting entrepreneurship in rural areas by providing various services such as market research, technology upgradation, and training.
subject: Business Studies

text: What is the significance of rural entrepreneurship in India?
options: It promotes economic development in urban areas
It promotes entrepreneurship in rural areas
It reduces poverty in urban areas
It promotes employment opportunities in rural areas
correctAnswer: It promotes entrepreneurship in rural areas
explanation: Rural entrepreneurship is significant in India as it promotes entrepreneurship in rural areas, which can lead to economic development and reduction of poverty.
subject: Business Studies

text: What is the main objective of the Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME) Act?
options: To promote entrepreneurship in urban areas
To promote entrepreneurship in rural areas
To provide financial assistance to small industries
To promote economic development in India
correctAnswer: To promote economic development in India
